ValidationRule.description: Throws error if the Case is not in the Card Disputes - General Queue or Card Disputes - Fraud Queue and the Record Type is not Direct Debit or Direct Entry.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Debit_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Entry_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'NPP_Dispute'), OR( Owner:Queue.QueueName != 'Support Coach Queue', Owner:Queue.QueueName != 'Digital Fraud Queue') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For this Dispute Type, please select either Support Coach Queue or Digital Fraud Queue.
